}

export default VariantSet;

// Generated by Lakar from component "Tombol solid". Import tokens.css once in your app.
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import styles from './TombolSolid.module.css';

export type TombolSolidProps = {
  tone?: "solid" | "ghost";
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function TombolSolid({ label = "Button", className, style }: TombolSolidProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.tombolSolid}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      <div className={styles.label}>
        {label}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default TombolSolid;
